name: São Tomé and Príncipe
flagName: Flag of São Tomé and Príncipe
summary: Green, yellow and green horizontal bands with a red triangle at the hoist and two black stars in the yellow band. The two stars represent the two main islands.
origin: The flag is based on that of the Movement for the Liberation of São Tomé and Príncipe (MLSTP). It was adopted after independence from Portugal on 12 July 1975.

colors.name: Yellow
colors.meaning: The sun and cocoa, the main export.

symbols.name: Two black stars
symbols.description: Two five-pointed black stars in the yellow band.
symbols.meaning: The two main islands, São Tomé and Príncipe.

history.label: Democratic Republic of São Tomé and Príncipe

facts: It is the second-smallest African country by area, after Seychelles.
The islands lie on the equator in the Gulf of Guinea.
Its black stars echo Ghana's 'Black Star of Africa'.
clues: Green, yellow and green bands with a red hoist triangle and two black stars.
Its two stars are two islands on the equator.
Its yellow is linked to cocoa.
